sections.heading: Document preview window does not open
sections.text: Document previews open in a new browser window. Browsers that block pop-ups for the application site prevent the preview from opening without showing an error.

steps.text: Ask the user to allow pop-ups for the application site in the browser settings.
Ask the user to select Preview again after allowing pop-ups.

information_needed.prompt: Browser name and version from the browser's About page.
